card.name: Partway through abbreviations and long words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of abbreviations, expansions like 'AST=' and long or split words such as 'benzodiazepines' or 'inhibitors', where the rest of the word or the '=' definition is expected next.

modes.label: Abbreviation lists
modes.description: Short abbreviations in a key like 'XXX=full term', just before the equals sign.
modes.example: Dosage Modification(s) Abbreviations: ALT=alanine aminotransferase;<< AST>>=aspartate aminotrans

modes.label: Inside split long words
modes.description: A middle piece of a long drug or technical word that is split into parts.
modes.example: CONCOMITANT USE WITH BENZ<<OD>>IAZEPINES OR OTHER CNS DE

modes.label: Codes and numbers
modes.description: A character inside a URL code or a numeric isotope label.

card.writes: Little clear output effect; it slightly favors punctuation and whitespace over word-start tokens.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of abbreviations and long split-up words, where more of the same word must follow.
